blocks.text: Winwyn Marquez and Mikee Quintos are among the 16 housemates introduced in the third installment of “Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab Edition.” The pilot episode premiered on Saturday, Oct. 24, which introduced a new batch of celebrities, content creators and ordinary Filipinos who will live together inside Kuya’s house for “PBB: Collab Edition 3.0.” Also representing GMA Network’s talent management arm Sparkle are actors Anthony Constantino and Raheel Bhyria. The Kapamilya lineup includes Star Magic artists Cianne Dominguez and Robbie Jaworski, as well as former UNIS member Gehlee Dangca. Content creators Lans Nagal and Jeo Ong are also part of the […]...
